This sub-species has adapted to thriving in particularly deep environments where very little light reaches. They are even more fierce than their counterparts who dwell closer to the surface. 死了。: 一种极端凶暴的大型猿类。苍白的皮肤和出色的夜视能力表明，它们在很久以前便已适应地下生活。

A fierce predator. It hisses menacingly, and venom drips from its fangs.
死了。: 凶猛的掠食者。它威胁地嘶嘶作响，毒液从尖牙滴落。

Black Phillip is a malevolent goat of immense size, exuding a sinister aura. Its fur is as dark as coal, and its eyes shimmer with an eerie, otherworldly light. Despite its large size, Black Phillip's movements are quick and fluid, enabling it to lunge at its prey with deadly accuracy. 死了。: 黑菲利普是一头体型巨大的恶毒山羊，散发着阴森的气息。它的毛色漆黑如煤，眼中闪烁着怪异的异界光芒。尽管体型庞大，黑菲利普的动作却迅捷流畅，能以致命的精准扑向猎物。此物似乎乐于用可怕的角重击毫无防备的受害者。人们相信黑菲利普是恶魔本身的化身。

A walking cadaver of towering proportions, it seems to have had the skin of countless other bodies poorly sewn over that of its own. Festering wounds on its hulk continually disgorge a putrid liquid.
死了。: 一具高大得骇人的行走尸骸，仿佛把无数其他尸体的皮肤粗劣地缝在自己身上。它庞大的身躯上溃烂伤口不断流出腐臭液体。

A vile dwarfish creature, clad in coarse brown robes. It has a cruel grin on its pale face, and its eyes are gleaming with hatred. The Bog Tcher are mechanically inclined, which they put to use by crafting sadistic weapons and traps. Their favored weapon is their "spike gun", which can pin the target against solid objects for prolonged suffering.

死了。: 这只半人半鼠的野兽沿着教堂墙缝潜行，扑向受害者，用发育不全的肢体撕挠血肉。作为黑色女主母偏爱的杂种，它每次啜饮她的黑血时，都会毫无理智地窃笑。

"There flapped rhythmically a horde of tame, trained, hybrid winged things... not altogether crows, nor moles, nor buzzards, nor ants, nor decomposed human beings, but something I cannot and must not recall."-H.P. Lovecraft, "The Festival".
死了。: “一群温顺、受训、混种的有翼之物有节奏地拍动着翅膀……既不完全像乌鸦，也不像鼹鼠、秃鹰、蚂蚁或腐烂的人类，而是某种我不能也不愿回忆的东西。”——H.P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《节日》。

It resembles an immense squid, with reaching, groping tentacles, and a pulpy, elongated sack of a body. Chthonians are powerful burrowers, and live for more than a thousand years.
死了。: 它像一只庞大的乌贼，伸出摸索的触手，身体则是柔软而细长的袋囊。地底巨蠕兽是强大的掘地者，寿命超过千年。

死了。: 一种在潮湿地带繁盛的病态增生物。它会产生毒性孢子，并将其储存在黏滑的头部。肉眼几乎不可见，却像蔓延的瘟疫般扩散。

Stitched together from a grotesque patchwork of decaying flesh, this enormous form looms like a nightmarish sentinel. 死了。: 由腐烂血肉的怪诞拼缀缝合而成，这具庞然形体像噩梦般的哨卫般矗立。它被自身不可思议的臃肿体量固定在原地，蛰伏不动，仿佛见证了孕育它的可怖实验。腐败液体从肿胀躯体中渗出，形成散发病态腐臭的死水坑。

A disembodied hand, crawling around frantically on its fingertips like a spider.
死了。: 一只脱离身体的手，像蜘蛛一样用指尖疯狂爬行。

A grotesque mummified hybrid creature, with the body of a human and the head of a crocodile. It is wielding a spear.
死了。: 一具怪诞的木乃伊混种，人体之上长着鳄鱼头。它手持长矛。

A fanatic cultist of the lowest rank, madly gibbering in some half-lost language. They may occasionally have learned to cast a spell or two, although never with any great skill. Therefore they tend to rely on mundane firearms to handle threats.
死了。: 最低阶的狂热邪教徒，用某种半失传的语言疯狂胡言。他们偶尔可能学会施放一两个法术，但从不精通。因此，他们往往依赖凡俗火器来处理威胁。

A fanatic cultist of the Arch Wizard rank, madly gibbering in some half-lost language.

A living incarnation of death. With its goat-like features, it is eerily similar to the imagery of Devils and Demons seen in medieval woodcuts.

A shambling thing which could be taken for a man were it not for its briny whiff and scaly skin. Slits on its neck emit a labored inflection, marking its struggle to gulp at breathable air. It hoists a rust-eaten spear and a net through which the thrashing remains of its last feast can be seen.
死了。: 若不是那股咸腥气和覆鳞皮肤，这个蹒跚之物或许会被当成人。它颈侧裂缝发出吃力的喘音，显示它正艰难吞咽可呼吸的空气。它举着锈蚀长矛和一张网，网中可见上一顿猎物仍在抽搐的残骸。

死了。: 这个可悲之物是复活动死肉的失败尝试。也许在过程开始前坏死已经推进太远，或许这只是某个缺乏相关原理知识者进行的狂野实验。它神情空洞地漫无目的蹒跚而行，因此显得有几分平静；然而它爪状手指的抽搐仍值得警惕。

Erupted from embers and ashes by nefarious wizardry, it has been endowed with animation in the form of a dreadful beast. Its breath exhales searing flames.

A spinning force of fire and destruction.

Flying polyps are a horrible elder race of half polypous, utterly alien entities. They are only partly material and have the power of aerial motion, despite the absence of wings. 死了。: 飞天水螅体是可怖的古老种族，半水螅状，彻底异质。它们只有部分物质形态，虽无翅膀却拥有空中运动能力。它们的感官并不包括视觉，但它们拥有的感官能够穿透一切物质阻碍。它们不受普通伤害影响，不过某些形式的电能可以摧毁它们。

A vaguely intelligent floating fungus-based organism. It contains a highly explosive gas and will detonate very easily, which it seems to desire.
死了。: 一种略有智能、以真菌为基础的漂浮生物。它含有高度爆炸性的气体，极易引爆，而且它似乎正渴望如此。

The freezing radiance emanating from this dancing flame provides no sense of comfort whatsoever - gazing upon it is disturbing to the very soul, and fills one with bitter hatred.
死了。: 这团跃动火焰散发的冰冷辉光丝毫不能带来慰藉；凝视它会扰动灵魂深处，并使人充满苦涩仇恨。

A gaunt, bipedal predator bearing canine features. Dried blood mottles its snout and its claws are filthy with sodden earth and chunks of flesh.
死了。: 一种瘦削的双足掠食者，带有犬类特征。干涸血迹斑驳在它的吻部，爪子沾满湿土与肉块。

An unknown species, perhaps stemming from some hidden bowels of the earth. It is about as tall as a full-grown human.
死了。: 一种未知物种，或许来自地底某处隐秘深处。它几乎有一个成年人那么高。
一只巨大的掠食性昆虫。

A loathsome beast hauling around a great sagging body on strained legs. Through its translucent, stretched skin the vile content of the creature's husk is clearly visible: carrion, human remains in various states of decomposition, trash, and sewage - along with other less recognizable things. Its head droops to the ground, where a tentacled mouth devours whatever filth it happens upon. It occasionally spews forth half-solid chunks of ooze, which after fermenting in the remarkable conditions of the creature's bowels, takes on a form of life of it's own - hunting for biological matter to decompose in order to feed its creator.
死了。: 一种令人作呕的野兽，用紧绷的腿拖着巨大而下垂的身体。透过半透明且被撑薄的皮肤，可以清楚看见这具躯壳中的污秽内容：腐肉、各种腐烂阶段的人类残骸、垃圾、污水，以及其他更难辨认的东西。它的头垂到地面，触手状口器吞食所遇到的一切污物。它偶尔会喷出半固态的软泥块，这些东西在其肠道的奇异环境中发酵后，会获得某种自己的生命形态，猎取生物质并将其分解，以供养创造者。

Flying polyps are a horrible elder race of half polypous, utterly alien entities. They are only partly material and have the power of aerial motion, despite the absence of wings. Vrka is a monstrous wolf-like creature dwelling in the High Priest's chambers, serving as a guardian.

Uraga is an undead master of deception and assassination, bound to guard the High Priest for all eternity.
死了。: 乌拉加是不死的欺诈与暗杀大师，被束缚着永远守卫大祭司。

Balastha is an undead master of arms and warfare, bound to guard the High Priest for all eternity. He is wielding a Tommy Gun.
死了。: 巴拉斯塔是不死的武器与战争大师，被束缚着永远守卫大祭司。他手持一把汤姆森冲锋枪。

A ropy, winged worm of vast size and vaporous composition. Brought forth from another plane of existence it drifts in endless search of sustenance, its maw hanging so agape it could swallow an ox whole.
死了。: 一条绳索般、有翼、体型庞大且构成如烟雾的蠕虫。它被从另一存在位面召来，在无尽地寻找食粮；巨口张得如此之大，仿佛能将一头牛整只吞下。

A writhing, crawling mass of intestines.
A mysterious humanoid figure stalking for prey. It is invisible to normal eyes.
死了。: 一个神秘的人形身影，潜伏猎食。普通眼睛看不见它。

A shrivelled hag who croaks of deviltry and possesses knowledge beyond the ken of a sane mind. She reigns over the myriad man-rat hybrids crawling within the dungeon, humoring her most cherished like a child: not once does she deny it the black blood that flows inside her veins.
死了。: 一个干瘪的老巫婆，嘎嘎谈论着魔鬼勾当，掌握着超出理智心智理解的知识。她统治着在地牢中爬行的无数人鼠混种，并像纵容孩子一样宠着自己最珍爱的那只：她从不拒绝让它饮用自己血管中流淌的黑血。

A vast, fully matured Khaga, the flight of this cryptic being conceals it from ordinary eyesight. It wails a disarmingly beautiful mantra which dissonates with the roar of the bolts it summons from its orb-like head.
死了。: 一只庞大而完全成熟的卡伽；这种隐秘存在飞行时会使普通视力无法察觉它。它哀鸣出一种令人卸下戒备的美丽真言，与它从球状头部召来的雷霆轰鸣形成不谐。

Shifting in and out of sight, this creature resembles a piece of cloth sailing through the aether, seemingly folding time-space along with its dreamy soar. Atop its craned neck rests an oblong orb with which it conjures deadly bolts to heave onto any threat.
死了。: 这生物时隐时现，像一块在以太中航行的布，梦幻般滑翔时似乎连同时间与空间一起折叠。它伸长的颈上顶着一颗椭圆球体，可借此召出致命雷矢投向任何威胁。

The mummified fourth dynasty Egyptian pharaoh Khephren. How he came to dwell here is beyond anyone's guess.
死了。: 第四王朝埃及法老卡夫拉的木乃伊。他为何会居于此处，没人能猜到。

The webs spun by this transcendental creature are not of any mundane kind - weaving, plucking, gnawing, it taps directly into the fabric of fate, making baleful arrangements according to its ulterior whims.
死了。: 这只超越凡俗的生物所织出的网绝非寻常之物；它编织、拨弄、啃噬，直接触及命运的织体，并按其隐秘恶意布置凶兆。

Ever watchful with leery eyes of insidious cunning, she fends for her brood as they stride between worlds through space and time.
死了。: 她总以阴险狡黠的斜眼警戒四周，在她的族群穿越空间与时间、跨行于诸界之间时护卫它们。

Marred by a mass of purplish cysts, the hide of this beast has been distended to absurdity, rendering it the size of a cow. It weaves webs as quickly as it strides, and its jaws are thick with rank lather.
